title: Vacation home rental — the Ashworths
instructions: The Ashworths rented their lake house at fair rent for **120 days** in 2025 and used it personally for **20 days**. Use the IRS method (rental days ÷ total days used) to allocate expenses. Round to the nearest dollar.

exhibits.title: 2025 amounts
exhibits.content:
Rental income: **$18,000**
Mortgage interest: **$8,000**
Property taxes: **$3,000**
Utilities and maintenance: **$4,200**
Depreciation (full year, if fully rental): **$7,000**

options: A dwelling used as a residence (rental expenses limited)
A rental property (losses may be allowed)

rows.label: Classification
rows.answer: A dwelling used as a residence (rental expenses limited)
rows.explanation: Personal use of 20 days exceeds the greater of 14 days or 10% of rental days (12).

rows.label: Rental share of mortgage interest and property taxes
Rental share of utilities and maintenance
Depreciation allowed
rows.explanation: Limited to remaining income: 18,000 − 9,429 − 3,600 = **4,971** (the rental share was 6,000).

rows.label: Net rental income
rows.explanation: Expenses are limited to rental income: **0**.
